player_prompt.intro:
O wena Ke Moshwantshi {player_id} ({piece}). Moshwantshi wa kganetsano ke ({opp}).
Romelang dikgato ka fa mofatong '[a2 a3]' (go tswa → go ya).
- Kgato ya tlwaelo ke kgato e le nngwe fela go ya kwa vertex e e kgaotseng e e kgakala.
- Go tshwara ke go tlela kgato kgatlhanong le moshwantshi wa kganetsano a re go wela kwa nodi e e kgaotseng e e kgakala.
Ditshwara tsotlhe di akgola {score_per_capture} di pointi.
Tau e fela morago ga {max_moves} dikgato kana fa moshwantshi a se na kgato e e siameng.

invalid_move.bad_format: Mokgwa o o sa siamang. Dirisa '[a2 a3]'.
invalid_move.unknown_square: Lekala le go sa itsiweng kwa le tswang teng.
invalid_move.not_your_piece: Motswedi ga se tiro ya gago.
invalid_move.dest_not_empty: Lefelo le a yang kwa go lone ga se la lefela.
invalid_move.illegal: Go tsamaya ka tsela e e seng kafa molaong.

outcome.cannot_move: Motshameki {player_id} ga a kgone go tsamaya.
outcome.higher_score: Go tshwara batho ba le bantsi.
outcome.move_limit: Tekanyetso ya go tsamaya e fitlhetswe.
